# Reviewed prospective source floor

Public synthetic input for HP-20, not a provider cassette or a human truth set.
Wire formats are /1. The scope explicitly selects `cited-entailment/2`.

| Artifact | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `scope.json` | Complete85-case roster and raw fixture pin |
| `fixtures/review-floor-v1.json` | Sources, assertions, 32 supported/52 unsupported/1 inconclusive reference declarations and two newly pinned reviews per case |
| `reviewers/*.json` | Complete old70-case criterion /1 source reviews, each69 affirmed/1 revise |
| `floor-review.json` | Every old-to-new disposition, seven contrasts, reviewer exposure and no remaining unresolved reference judgments |

The original disputed runbook assertion stays a required unsupported control. Its
unambiguous positive replacement is additional. Clear unknown-to-confirmed
strengthening is Unsupported. Equal-authority contradictory observations with no
resolution are Inconclusive. Neither is a statement about source authenticity.

Two separately instructed agents reviewed the full source with expected labels
and peer outputs withheld. They share a model family and had prior own /1
exposure before full /2 review. Identity and technical isolation are unverified.
Agreement is not calibrated accuracy or actual human evidence. Structured source
fact IDs replace redundant private-path display links in portable review bases;
raw outputs and normalization receipts are retained privately.

`TestOwnerFloorCLIReviewedDataAndPrivacy` drives the real command entrypoint with
these files. It checks binding, complete coverage, privacy and refusal, not whether
the source judgments are true. The failed original studies remain unchanged.
